integrity: The infinite theorem is proved analytically. Finite exhaustive computation is used only as an independent stress test of low orders and the construction.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats ordinary total bondage of crown graphs only; it does not classify k-total bondage for k at least 2.
The original 1991 Kulli--Patwari full text was not used to support a whole-document noncoverage assertion; comparison uses the later survey and the inspected 2025 paper.
A poorly indexed equivalent result under an alternate name for crown graphs remains a residual literature risk.
title: Total bondage number of crown graphs
